name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one
summary: Multiply the lifts by E^n: at a = 0 the standard exponent rises from −u to −u + n ≥ 0, which is the level-one standard exponent.

steps.claim: By mem_liftIdeal_iff take t·E^n for t; for c, the lift x (standard exponents of level 0) gives E^n·x = frobEUnit(0)^n·x, which has the standard exponents of level 1 (frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents: at a = 0 the required 0 ≤ −u + n holds by hn, at a ≥ 1 nothing changes), and projTriv(S)(E^n x) = (sE^n − r·tE^n)·constantAt(S, i)(c).
steps.lean:
mem_liftIdeal_iff.2 ((mem_liftIdeal_iff.1 H).imp' (· * _ ^ n)
  fun _ ↦ forall_imp fun _ ⟨_, s, q⟩ ↦ ⟨_, frobEUnit_zpow_mem_withExponents 0 n s
  (by rintro ⟨⟩ <;> simp_all), by simp [*, frobEUnit_pow_smul]; module⟩)
